events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Nigel Bradham picked off Aaron Rodgers' pass in the end zone with 20 seconds left, Jordan Howard gashed Green Bay for his second career three-touchdown game and the Philadelphia Eagles ended a two-game losing streak with 34-27 victory over the Packers...
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles pick off Rodgers' late pass, beat Packers 34-27

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw three first-half touchdown passes, two to A.J. Brown, and the Tennessee Titans defense had three fourth-down stops to beat the Atlanta Falcons 24-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota throws 3 first-half TD passes, Titans drop Falcons

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Patriots linebacker Jamie Collins forced Buffalo's fourth turnover by intercepting backup Matt Barkley's pass with 1:27 remaining to seal New England's 16-10 win over the Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots stay undefeated, hang on to beat Bills 16-10

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Darrel Williams ran for a go-ahead, 1-yard touchdown with 23 seconds left for his second score in the fourth quarter, lifting the Kansas City Chiefs to a 34-30 win over the Detroit Lions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs score late, stay undefeated with 34-30 win over Lions

headlines.description: Derek Carr led the Oakland Raiders to touchdowns on three of their first four possessions Sunday, and Erik Harris returned a late interception 30 yards for a score to seal a 31-24 victory at Indianapolis.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders use fast start, interception return to beat Colts

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 310 yards and two scores Sunday to help the Chargers win in Miami for the first time in 38 years, 30-10.
headlines.shortLinkText: Long time coming: Rivers, Chargers beat Dolphins, 30-10

headlines.description: Daniel Jones worked his magic again, Saquon Barkley's replacement Wayne Gallman scored two touchdowns, and Jabrill Peppers scored on a 32-yard interception return to lead the suddenly revived New York Giants to 24-3 victory over the winless Washington...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones, defense lead Giants over winless Redskins, 24-3

headlines.description: Finally fulfilling preseason expectations, Baker Mayfield and the Cleveland Browns posted a signature win against a longtime nemesis.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield and Chubb combine to carry Browns past Ravens 40-25

headlines.description: Kyle Allen threw for 232 yards and the Carolina Panthers overcame his three fumbles with help from a big defensive play late to get a 16-10 win over the Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers down Texans 16-10 despite Allen's fumbles

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Jameis Winston passed for 385 yards and threw two of his four touchdown passes to Chris Godwin, and Ndamukong Suh returned Jared Goff's fumble 37 yards for a touchdown with 1:06 to play in the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' 55-40 victory over the previously...
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws 4 TD passes, Buccaneers outlast Rams 55-40

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for 240 yards a touchdown, Jadeveon Clowney returned an interception for a touchdown and the Seattle Seahawks beat the Arizona Cardinals 27-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks grind to 27-10 win over Cardinals

headlines.description: Chase Daniel threw for 195 yards and a touchdown after Mitchell Trubisky got knocked out of the game with a left shoulder injury on the opening possession, and the Chicago Bears swarmed NFL rushing leader Dalvin Cook in a 16-6 victory over the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears lose Trubisky, shut down Cook in 16-6 win over Vikings

headlines.description: Leonard Fournette ran for a career-high 225 yards and Josh Lambo kicked a 33-yard field goal as time expired, sending the Jacksonville Jaguars past the winless Denver Broncos 26-24 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fournette leads Jags' 26-24 comeback over Broncos

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Vonn Bell's forced fumble and two recoveries helped the Saints stifle a Dallas offense that had rolled through its first three games, and Wil Lutz kicked four field goals to lift New Orleans to a 12-10 victory over the Cowboys on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints top Cowboys in 12-10 defensive struggle

headlines.description: Mason Rudolph threw for 229 yards and two touchdowns to pick up his first victory while filling in for Ben Roethlisberger as the Pittsburgh Steelers easily handled the Cincinnati Bengals 27-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers break out of funk, stomp Bengals 27-3
